text: Brooks ain't no bug. He's just institutionalized.
author: Ellis Boyd "Red" Redding
visual_brief: Precise architectural elevation and section of an antique wire aviary with fine orthographic linework. The arched cage door is swung wide on hinge guidelines indicated by dashed motion arcs, revealing a weathered wooden perch and sheltered seed tray inside.
